The question "Can vegans eat oysters?" elicits conflicting opinions within the vegan community and among commentators [d1, d2, d3, d4, d5]. Some argue that oysters, lacking a central nervous system and likely incapable of feeling pain, can be consumed by "ostrovegans" [d3, d9, d10]. The debate centers on differing interpretations of sentience, pain, and the definition of veganism itself [d6, d8], with no scientific consensus on oyster sentience from the retrieved evidence [d2, d6].
